summary: Staging provisioning pipeline fails during Terraform apply: AccessDenied (missing iam:PassRole) for fleet-provisioner role
description:
Issue summary
- Provision-to-ready automation pilot in staging fails consistently at the IaC/provisioning stage when the Fleet Provisioner triggers Terraform apply for a new Dedicated pool.
- Error indicates the staging fleet-provisioner execution role is missing iam:PassRole permissions for the EKS node role (and associated instance profile) used by the module.

Impact
- Blocks staging pilot (ENG-2752) for end-to-end provision-to-ready pipeline.
- No prod impact. However, blocks validation of readiness gates and time-to-ready metrics end-to-end.

Environment
- Account: staging
- Region: us-east-1
- Service: Fleet Provisioner (control-plane triggered)
- Terraform modules: dedicated-pool (networking/compute/bootstrap)

Steps to reproduce
1) Trigger a provisioning run for a staging test pool:
   - redwoodctl fleet provision --pool stg-dedicated-pool-07 --region us-east-1 --dry-run=false
   (or via control plane "Trigger provisioning run" endpoint)
2) Observe provisioning run transitions into "Provisioning" and then fails when Terraform apply runs.

Expected
- Terraform apply completes and emits standard outputs (cluster endpoint, nodegroup IDs, kubeconfig bootstrap artifacts), allowing the run to proceed to Imaging/Bootstrapping.

Actual
- Terraform apply fails with AccessDenied on iam:PassRole.

Logs (Fleet Provisioner / Terraform apply)
- Correlation ID: provrun_01HRQ7K4M2H3Z8V7B8D2K9

```
2025-02-26T18:41:12.913Z  INFO  fleet-provisioner  stage=Provisioning action=terraform.apply module=dedicated-pool region=us-east-1 pool=stg-dedicated-pool-07
2025-02-26T18:41:44.207Z ERROR  fleet-provisioner  terraform apply failed: exit status 1

Error: creating EKS Node Group (stg-dedicated-pool-07-ng-0): AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::2109********:assumed-role/redwood-stg-fleet-provisioner/fleet-provisioner is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::2109********:role/redwood-stg-eks-node
	status code: 403, request id: 1d3c0b8c-2f5d-4e3f-8c0b-8d1f1a2f9a0c

2025-02-26T18:41:44.211Z  WARN  fleet-provisioner  stage=Provisioning transition=Failed reason=TerraformApplyFailed error_category=AuthZ
```

Notes / suspected cause
- The dedicated-pool module uses a node IAM role that must be passed by the provisioning role during nodegroup creation.
- Staging policy for redwood-stg-fleet-provisioner appears to have been tightened recently (or never included PassRole for this role pattern).

Links
- Slack thread: #eng-infra (Terraform apply failures IAM/quotas) sources/slack/eng-infra/1708621444.json
- Linear work item tracking staging pilot: ENG-2752
- Confluence runbook (provisioning): sources/confluence/eng-infra/runbooks/dedicated-pool-provisioning-runbook.json
- Confluence module structure: sources/confluence/eng-infra/terraform-and-iac/dedicated-pool-iac-module-structure.json
resolution: Fixed staging IAM policy for fleet-provisioner to allow iam:PassRole on the expected EKS node role(s) used by dedicated-pool modules. Validated by re-running Terraform apply and completing Provisioning stage successfully for stg-dedicated-pool-07.

2025-02-26 19:05 Harish Reddy (Reporter)
Seeing staging pilot provisioning fail repeatedly at Terraform apply. Error is AccessDenied on iam:PassRole for arn:aws:iam::2109********:role/redwood-stg-eks-node. Correlation ID provrun_01HRQ7K4M2H3Z8V7B8D2K9. Blocking ENG-2752.

2025-02-26 19:22 Nina Petrova (Assignee)
Confirmed repro on a second pool (stg-dedicated-pool-08). This is not a quota issue; it fails immediately once nodegroup resource is created. I’m going to diff the staging fleet-provisioner role policy vs prod and check recent IAM changes.

2025-02-26 20:01 Kevin Osei
+1 this looks like a least-privilege gap. If we add iam:PassRole, please scope it to specific role ARNs/patterns used by the dedicated-pool module and document it (avoid *).
